description: This file contains unit tests for the NoteService class, verifying its behavior such as creating, updating, deleting, retrieving, and listing notes, as well as checking audit logging functions.

classes.name: NoteServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the NoteService functionality including create, update, delete, get, and list operations, with mock dependencies and audit logging verification.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock dependencies and creates an instance of NoteService before each test case.

methods.name: create_shouldCreateNote_andLogAudit
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new note and verifies that an audit log is generated.

methods.name: update_shouldApplyChanges_andLogBeforeAfter
methods.description: Verifies that updating a note applies the changes and logs the before and after states.

methods.name: delete_shouldRemove_andLogDelete
methods.description: Ensures that deleting a note removes it from repository and logs the delete action.

methods.name: get_shouldThrowNotFound_whenMissing
methods.description: Checks that fetching a non-existent note throws a NoSuchElementException.

methods.name: list_shouldReturnPage
methods.description: Tests that listing notes returns a correct page of notes and logs the read action.
